preconditions.description: The number of computers is at least 1 and at most 100,000.
The number of cables is at least 1 and at most 200,000.
The indices of the computers connected by each cable are between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of cables in the final scheme is at least the number of the already present cables.

postconditions.expression: Each pair of printed cables (ci, di) must be a valid connection between two computers.
postconditions.description: The printed cables must represent a valid network configuration.

postconditions.expression: No two cables in the final scheme should have information flowing in opposite directions.
postconditions.description: The direction of information flow must be consistent for each cable.

postconditions.expression: There must be a solution where p does not exceed 500,000.
postconditions.description: The solution must be feasible with a maximum of 500,000 cables.
